caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock case with ornate carvings, particularly at the top, where there are scroll and leaf patterns along with two finials on either side. The wood is dark brown with visible grain and decorative, twisted columns framing the front. The clock face is near the upper center, featuring a round dial with black Roman numerals, black hour and minute hands, and gold detailing at the center and corners of the dial. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular painted panel bordered with yellow and black geometric patterns. This panel shows a landscape with a white house with a blue roof and red chimneys, green grass, several trees, and a yellow-and-black circular motif in the center resembling a gear or medallion. The clock rests on four short, carved legs and the outer edge of the paper is bordered with a thin red line. The background is an off-white or beige color, and there is a small handwritten inscription at the lower right corner.
title: Clock
